hints.en: Under the step, `env:` with `TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}` inside it.
No `${{ }}` should remain in the command, only `$TITLE` and `$BRANCH`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: PR Check

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  title:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "Checking PR $TITLE"
        env:
          TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}
      - run: echo "From branch $BRANCH"
        env:
          BRANCH: ${{ github.head_ref }}
```
hints.en:
The full solution:
